title: Readable Is Not Steerable: Pre-Registered Tests of Physical Structure in Learned Fluid Representations
summary: Preregistered held-out tests in 2D Navier-Stokes simulations found a specific mismatch between latent readability and controllability; this is not evidence of a new fluid law. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: JEPA and autoencoder representations of simulated 2D Navier–Stokes flows are tested for readable and steerable physical quantities.
